title: Help and safety
lead: If you're in danger or someone hurt you, you're not alone. These services are free and confidential.

sms.label: Emergencies by text, if you can't speak

report.title: Report outside the app
report.violence: Report sexual or gender-based violence to the police, online, 24/7

schools.title: At your school
schools.lead: Each school has a service against sexual and gender-based violence. You can contact them even if it happened off campus.
schools.epita: EPITA violence reporting platform (link on the intranet)
schools.esme: ESME reporting platform (link on the intranet)
schools.supbiotech: Sup'Biotech reporting platform (link on the intranet)
schools.isg: ISG Lyon officer for sexual and gender-based violence (contact the administration)
schools.verified: Links checked at the start of every academic year.

inApp.title: In Epilove
inApp.block: Block: immediate, mutual, the person isn't told.
inApp.report: Report: from a profile, a photo or a message. It's anonymous for the reported person.
inApp.hide: Hide specific people or your school, from settings.
